svg.title: Abdominal wall layers
svg.desc: Anterior view in three panels, superficial to deep. Left: external oblique (fibres run inferomedially) beside rectus abdominis. Middle: external oblique removed to show internal oblique (fibres superomedial). Right: both obliques and the rectus removed to show transversus abdominis with horizontal fibres.
